jobs.title: Data Engineer I
jobs.description: Are you passionate about building data pipelines and turning raw information into actionable insights? Do you enjoy designing solutions that help teams make smarter, faster decisions? As a Data Engineer I at Amazon, you will build and maintain data solutions that power critical business decisions across the organization. You will work with large-scale datasets, design efficient data models, and create automated pipelines that process millions of data points. This is an opportunity to grow your technical skills while collaborating with analysts, data scientists, and engineers who rely on your work to unlock the value hidden in data. If you are curious, resourceful, and energized by solving real problems with data, we want to hear from you. Key job responsibilities - Design, implement, and maintain data pipelines and ETL workflows that ingest, transform, and persist data from multiple sources at scale. - Create and optimize physical data models, applying best practices in schema design, partitioning, indexing, and query performance tuning to ensure reliable and efficient data access. - Write secure, testable, and well-documented code using scripting and query languages such as SQL, Python, or Scala to automate data processing and support analytical workloads. - Collaborate with business analysts, data scientists, and engineering partners to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions that meet business needs. - Monitor data pipelines for operational issues, troubleshoot root causes, and resolve defects to maintain data integrity and system reliability. A day in the life You will start your day reviewing pipeline health dashboards and addressing any data quality alerts. From there, you might refine a data model to support a new reporting requirement, write and test ETL code, or pair with a teammate to review a schema change. Expect regular conversations with analysts and data scientists who depend on your pipelines, helping you stay connected to the business impact of your work. You will also participate in design discussions and code reviews, continuously sharpening your skills in a collaborative engineering environment. About the team Amazon's Global Logistics (GL) Exports team supports Amazon's vision of offering customers worldwide cross-border product selection at competitive prices. We build the data infrastructure and analytics that power smart, data-driven decisions for customers, sellers, and vendors navigating international trade and logistics. Our work directly shapes Amazon's ability to scale globally and deliver innovative e-commerce solutions. We value collaboration, continuous learning, and operational excellence. You'll join a group of engineers who support each other through mentorship, knowledge sharing, and constructive feedback. We're investing in scalable, well-architected data solutions, and we're excited to welcome team members who want to grow their careers while making a meaningful impact on how Amazon uses data to connect the world. - 1+ years of data engineering experience - Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines - Experience with one or more query language (e.g., SQL, PL/SQL, DDL, MDX, HiveQL, SparkSQL, Scala) - Experience with one or more scripting language (e.g., Python, KornShell) - Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions - Experience with big data technologies such as: Hadoop, Hive, Spark, EMR - Experience with any ETL tool like, Informatica, ODI, SSIS, BODI, Datastage, etc. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits . USA, WA, Bellevue - 101,300.00 - 160,000.00 USD annually

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Agentic AI
jobs.description: Amazon's Agentic AI and Emerging Tech organization is building distributed systems and developer experience products used by engineers inside Amazon and by external customers. We are hiring a Software Development Engineer II to help create the next generation of AI-agent-driven automation, where intelligent agents take developer intent and autonomously plan, code, test, and deploy. In this role, you will own features end-to-end across the full software lifecycle and write high-quality, maintainable code that directly improves how engineers work. If you want to shape the tools and infrastructure that redefine software development, we would love to hear from you. Key job responsibilities - Design and implement distributed systems and developer tooling across the full software lifecycle, including scoping, architecture, coding, testing, deployment, and operational support. - Collaborate with product managers, stakeholders, and engineering peers to translate customer and business needs into well-defined technical requirements and working software. - Identify root causes of operational issues and resolve them with permanent fixes, continuously improving system reliability and performance using AWS services such as Lambda, DynamoDB, and S3. - Mentor fellow engineers through code reviews and knowledge sharing, raising the technical bar across the team while producing clear documentation for the software you build. - Evaluate and integrate generative AI capabilities where appropriate to augment productivity and solution quality, applying responsible practices to refine outputs and accelerate development. A day in the life You might start your morning reviewing a design document for a new distributed systems feature, then jump into a code review where you help a teammate strengthen their approach. After a quick standup, you spend focused time writing and testing code for a developer experience capability you own. In the afternoon, you pair with a product manager to clarify requirements for an upcoming AI-agent workflow and wrap up by investigating an operational alert to identify its root cause and plan a permanent fix. About the team Our team sits within Amazon's Agentic AI and Emerging Tech organization, where we focus on building distributed systems and developer experience products that serve both internal Amazon engineers and external customers. We are working to automate the software development lifecycle through AI agents. We value collaboration, technical rigor, and getting the details right. Every engineer has the opportunity to influence our technical direction and contribute ideas that shape what we build. We maintain an inclusive environment where questions are welcomed and knowledge is shared freely. - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience - 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience - 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience - 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience - Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field - Experience programming with at least one software programming language - 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.title: Field Service Engineer 1
jobs.description: The group you’ll be a part of The Customer Support Business Group focuses on enabling our customers with premier customer support throughout their lifecycle with Lam. We drive performance, productivity, safety, and quality of customers installed base performance and deliver service and lifecycle solutions for their most critical equipment and processes. The impact you’ll make As a Field Service Engineer at Lam, you will step into the limelight of customer support. Your work goes beyond installations and troubleshooting; it ensures the operational excellence of our complex semiconductor equipment. You're on the front lines, understanding customer needs and collaborating with various teams to deliver solutions. What you’ll do Provide quality on-site repair, maintenance service of Lam’s equipment at customer sites. Troubleshoot equipment problems and conduct diagnostic procedures to isolate problems. Take steps to minimize downtime, system interruptions, and equipment malfunctions. Identify corrective actions required and request assistance from experienced staff for guidance when assessing severity of malfunctions. Undergo on the job training to assist with installation, start-up, or relocation of equipment at customer’s site. Keep up to date on semiconductor capital equipment and Lam products through learning, training, and certification. Who we’re looking for Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree with no previous professional experience; or equivalent work experience. Proficiency in interpreting electrical and mechanical schematics, diagrams, and operation manuals. Able to work in a clean room environment while wearing personal protective safety equipment, or cleanroom suit. Frequently position oneself (e.g., bend, stoop, reach, walk, sit, twist, squat, kneel, climb, stand) to perform job tasks for extended periods. Able to travel frequently, domestically and internationally, based on customer needs, flexibility to work a variety shifts including compressed and alternative workweeks including overtime and on-call if needed. This is a graduate eligible role. Preferred qualifications Proficiency in basic computer skills and familiarity with common office software including Microsoft Office Suite. Prior experience working in electronics field a plus. Communication skills, both written and verbal, in English. Foundational analytical and problem-solving skills. Our commitment We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results. Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees. Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On-site Flex’ you’ll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time. Our Perks and Benefits At Lam, our people make amazing things possible. That’s why we invest in you throughout the phases of your life with a comprehensive set of outstanding benefits.
